moved.sentence: Reusing or omitting server-side challenge verification (replay risk) — **MUST NOT**.

judged.note: Reusing or omitting server-side challenge verification is kept at MUST NOT with the replay-risk reason.

moved.sentence: Setting `rp.id` to a host that doesn't cover the auth origin.

judged.note: Setting rp.id to a host that does not cover the auth origin, an unkeyed anti-pattern, is kept at SHOULD NOT.

moved.sentence: Treating a passkey as a bearer secret or syncing the RP private key (there is none server-side).

judged.note: Treating a passkey as a bearer secret or syncing the RP private key is kept at SHOULD NOT, with the note that there is none server-side.

moved.sentence: Request attestation (`attestation: "direct"`) **only** when policy needs to verify authenticator make/model.

judged.note: Requesting direct attestation only when policy must verify authenticator make/model is kept at SHOULD with the MEASURED-NEED/YAGNI condition.
Using attestation none for consumer flows is kept at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Issue a fresh server-side `challenge` per attempt; verify origin, `rp.id`, UP flag, and signature against the stored public key.

judged.note: A fresh server-side challenge per authentication attempt and verification of origin, rp.id, UP flag and signature are kept at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Prefer **discoverable credentials** (resident keys) so users authenticate without first entering a username.

judged.note: Preferring discoverable credentials so users skip entering a username is kept at SHOULD with its reason.

moved.sentence: Provide an explicit, rate-limited account-recovery path (e.g. verified email magic link plus identity proofing) for users who lose all authenticators.

judged.note: An explicit, rate-limited account-recovery path for users who lose all authenticators is kept at SHOULD with the same example.

moved.sentence: Always allow registering additional passkeys from an authenticated session.

judged.note: Always allowing additional passkeys to be registered from an authenticated session is kept, now at MUST.

moved.sentence: Set `rp.id` to the registrable domain; set `user.id` to an opaque, stable, non-PII handle (not an email).

judged.note: rp.id set to the registrable domain and user.id set to an opaque, stable, non-PII handle (not an email) are kept at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Store the credential id, public key, signature counter, transports, and the AAGUID for later UX.

judged.note: Storing credential id, public key, signature counter, transports and AAGUID for later UX is kept at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Target the **W3C WebAuthn Level 2 Recommendation** (`webauthn-2`) for stable, broadly-implemented behavior.

judged.note: Targeting WebAuthn Level 2 Recommendation for stable, broadly-implemented behavior is kept at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: **WebAuthn Level 3** (`webauthn-3`) is a **W3C Candidate Recommendation (2026-01-13)** — FORECAST: treat its newer features (e.g. refined attestation, related-origin requests) as evolving; do not depend on them as universally available until they reach Recommendation.

judged.note: Level 3's Candidate Recommendation status (2026-01-13), treating its newer features as evolving and not depending on them until Recommendation, is kept with the FORECAST label.
